name_zh: 淄博市周村古商城景区
address_zh: 山东省淄博市周村区新建中路1号
address_en: No. 1, Xinjian Middle Road, Zhoucun District, Zibo City, Shandong Province
intro_zh: 周村古商城景区位于山东省淄博市周村区，素有“旱码头”“金周村”“丝绸之乡”的美誉。景区总占地面积60.5公顷，主要由大街、丝市街、银子市街等古街组成，现有保存完好的明清古建筑5万余平方米。周村古商城历经数百年风雨至今仍保留完好，街区纵横，店铺林立，建筑风格迥异，被中国古建筑保护委员会的专家誉为“中国活着的古商业建筑博物馆群”，具有很高的旅游观光价值。
intro_en: Zhoucun Ancient Mall Scenic Area is located in Zhoucun District, Zibo City, Shandong Province. It is known as the "Dry Wharf", "Jinzhou Village" and "The Hometown of Silk". The scenic area covers a total area of ​​60.5 hectares and is mainly composed of ancient streets such as Main Street, Silk Street, and Yinzi Street. There are more than 50,000 square meters of well-preserved ancient buildings from the Ming and Qing Dynasties. After hundreds of years of ups and downs, Zhoucun Ancient Mall is still well-preserved, with criss-crossed streets, numerous shops, and different architectural styles. It is hailed by experts from the China Ancient Buildings Protection Committee as "China's living museum group of ancient commercial buildings" and has high tourism value.
